name: @estate/bun-scaffold
description: Maximal Bun scaffold: copy-paste package.json + bunfig.toml + gate (validate/test:coverage/typecheck) + a freeinference deepseek completions helper for applying it across estate projects.

scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run lint
scripts.coverage:ratchet: bun test --coverage --coverage.reporter=json-summary && bun x vyper-spec coverage:ratchet
scripts.lint: bun x biome check src tests
